1.initial:
Configure SSO :

1.(Server and Client side) : Have two PCs on the LAN of SonicWALL joined the domain. One PC should be a domain controller with Domain users and groups configured on it. Install a Sonicwall SSO Agent on the DC. Set a shared key on the Sonicwall SSO Agent and enter SonicWALL's LAN IP address in the agent's properties.
The other PC is a workstation where a domain user should log in to the domain.
2.Firewall Side : Go to the Users>Settings page. Select Sonicwall SSO Agent for the Single-sign-on method. 3. Click the Configure button. In the Settings tab of the Sonicwall SSO Agent Authentication Configuration window enter the IP address of the PC with Sonicwall SSO Agent running. Enter the shared key matching the one set on the agent and Save the configuration, Test the connectivity in the Test Tab
1.title: Address objects are auto-added in the "SonicWALL SSO Agents" group as agents are added.
1.result:
1.The "SSO Agent" address object is displayed in the Address Objects table.
2.The "SSO Agent" object is shown as a member of the "SonicWALL SSO Agents" group object

2.steps: On the Users>Settings page, select "SonicWALL SSO Agent" as Single-sign-on method. Click the Configure button next to it. 2. In the Settings tab of the SonicWALL SSO Agent Authentication Configuration window, click the "Add..." button. 3. Type an IP address in the Host Name or IP Address field. Fill in the Shared Key and Confirm Shared Key fields. Keep the default port number (2258) in the Port field. Click the Apply button in the SonicWALL SSO Agent Authentication Configuration window. 4. Repeat the previous step using the same port number. Click OK and close the window.5. On the Firewall > Services page, view Services and Service Groups tables.

5.title: Add a maximum number of agents.
5.result:
The limit on number of SSO Agents with Auth Partition is "No. of Auth Partitions * 8" where "No. of Auth Partitions" is platform specific. So for example, NSA3600 MAX auth partition is 12, 12 * 8 = 96.
"No. of Auth Partitions * 8" where "No. of Auth Partitions"agent are shown in the Settings tab of the SonicWALL SSO Agent Authentication Configuration window. The attempt to add the next agent entry fails.
